title: "Energy Revolution? More like a Crawl" - Dr. Vaclav Smil
channel: Trottier Institute for Sustainability in Engineering and Design
summary: Energy scholar Vaclav Smil argues that global energy transitions are slow and that renewable targets should not rest on wishful thinking. He appraises how energy dependencies are likely to change and asks for using much less.
why: HN recommends it as a grounded, data-driven counter to hype about quick energy revolutions.

quote.text: I really suggest watching this talk by Smil
